<FI> And<Fi> of the Hebronites<WH02276>, Hashabiah<WH02811> and his brethren<WH0251>, men<WH01121> of valour<WH02428>, a thousand<WH0505> and seven<WH07651> hundred<WH03967>, <FI>were<Fi> officers<WH06486> among them of Israel<WH03478> on this side<WH05676> Jordan<WH03383> westward<WH04628> in all the business<WH04399> of the LORD<WH03068>, and in the service<WH05656> of the king<WH04428>. <RF>officers...: Heb. over the charge<Rf>
